dedupe_keys.name: dataset for a two phase nonlinear optimization method for district heating systems

description: The deposit provides inputs and results for a two-stage district-heating network optimisation study. The method combines mixed-integer linear topology and pipe sizing with nonlinear refinement and gradual diameter discretisation. The provider is Lambert, Jerry; Spliethoff, Hartmut. Coverage: The proof of concept concerns a town network with 400 consumers and one design point. The public record does not identify its geography or time-varying demand coverage. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The reported run time and solution quality are study-specific claims. One design point does not establish performance across operational seasons or networks. For simulation it supplies a reproducibility case for network-expansion and pipe-sizing algorithms. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
